name: gwsadm-mcp
description: Google Workspace security-audit MCP server, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: gwsadm-mcp
plugins.description: Google Workspace security-audit MCP for Claude Code, through a service account with domain-wide delegation. Investigate suspicious/disabled logins, suspended accounts, third-party OAuth grants, Drive external sharing, group delivery policy, and Gmail message tracing across one or more Workspace domains, plus a one-shot daily_brief. Read-only — no Directory/Reports/Gmail write calls anywhere in this package. Needs a local GWSADM_CONFIG INI file, and the Google Cloud service-account JSON key(s) it references, already present on the machine; the plugin cannot create or supply those files for you.
